label: rem:noble-gas-characterization-interpretation
title: Mathematical novelty of the full-shell characterization
html:
Each electron is the word e^- = \sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0 \in B_3 (electron knot), the positive half twist on three strands, with writhe 3. Its closure is the Hopf link. A closed sub-Hopf link at level n is a chain where every electron is fully linked with its neighbours. No crossing can be added or removed without breaking the sub-link.

This yields:

Full shell = no free linking site.

A shell fills by exhausting available linking sites at its level, not by reaching a numerical threshold. Topological rigidity drives inertness. No crossing remains available for a new electron.

Remark (mathematical novelty). This topological characterization replaces heuristic chemistry with a rigid sub-Hopf link invariant. It formally binds empirical ionization energy peaks to crossing-energy maxima.
